purpose_context: Before building the ingestion pipeline, two architecture decisions remain open and block later work: which backend the searchable wiki/RAG sink uses, and how large binary documents are stored in the raw repository. This mission is a lightweight research spike that produces a documented recommendation (an ADR) for each decision, so the foundations mission and everything downstream can proceed on settled ground.
purpose_tldr: Resolve the two remaining open architecture decisions (wiki/RAG sink backend and large-binary handling) so downstream pipeline missions are unblocked.
